observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlight assembly with a clear lens, a circular main bulb housing, and a yellow turn signal section.
The assembly has a black plastic housing with visible mounting tabs and a small protrusion on the top right.
The surface is dusty and shows signs of wear and possible impact damage.
A watermark 'HONDA AND ACURA POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the image.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlight itself.

risks.risk: The part may not be compatible with the buyer's vehicle model.
risks.proof: A photo showing the part installed on a vehicle or a clear view of the mounting points and any model-specific markings.

risks.risk: The part may be a counterfeit or non-original replacement.
risks.proof: A photo of the part's serial number or a close-up of any manufacturer markings, or a photo of the part installed on a known vehicle.

Photo showing the part installed on a vehicle or a clear view of mounting points and any model-specific markings.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
